n9ad32da0ca.headline: Anglo American exits steelmaking coal business with $3.9bn asset sale
n9ad32da0ca.summary: Anglo American is exiting its steelmaking coal business in a $3.9 billion asset sale. Peabody Energy will pay $2.05 billion upfront and a deferred payment of $725 million for the rest of the portfolio.
n9ad32da0ca.why: Anglo American is a global mining group, and steelmaking coal is a key input for steel production, so portfolio changes affect its earnings and capital allocation.

impacts.name: Anglo American
impacts.why: Anglo American is selling its steelmaking coal business, changing its portfolio.

n9d1d952204.headline: CBI chief hits out at Reeves after firms face ‘heavy burden’ from tax rises
n9d1d952204.summary: CBI chief executive Rain Newton-Smith said firms face tough decisions on hiring and investment because of the Budget's tax rises. She directed the criticism at Chancellor Rachel Reeves.
n9d1d952204.why: The CBI is the UK's main business lobby group, and its views shape policy debate on taxation, investment and employment.

nea65fb6078.headline: Blackstone :  EQT Announces $3.5 Billion Midstream Joint Venture with Blackstone Credit & Insurance
nea65fb6078.summary: EQT Corporation has signed a definitive agreement with funds managed by Blackstone Credit & Insurance to form a new midstream joint venture valued at $3.5 billion, according to the announcement.
nea65fb6078.why: EQT is a large US natural gas producer, and midstream assets such as pipelines link gas production to markets. Joint ventures like this bring in private capital to fund infrastructure.

n7f42639e54.headline: Kazakhstan's Public Debt Remains at ‘Comfortable Level,’ Says Economy Minister
n7f42639e54.summary: Kazakhstan's Minister of National Economy Nurlan Baibazarov said the country's public debt remains at a comfortable level.
n7f42639e54.why: Public debt levels influence sovereign credit ratings and borrowing costs for Kazakhstan's government bonds.

nd4e2a740a1.headline: KE :  Announces Third Quarter 2024 Unaudited Financial Results Form 6 K
nd4e2a740a1.summary: KE Holdings, an integrated online and offline platform for housing transactions, has released unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2024. The company is based in Beijing.
nd4e2a740a1.why: KE Holdings operates Beike, a major Chinese housing transaction platform, so its results are a read on China's property market.

n57652d526d.headline: Kazakhstan Plans to Export 68.8 Million Tons of Oil This Year
n57652d526d.summary: Kazakhstan plans to export 68.8 million tons of oil this year, according to The Astana Times. The report gives no further detail on routes or buyers.
n57652d526d.why: Kazakhstan is a major oil producer in Central Asia, and its export volumes affect global crude supply and the revenues of its state-linked producers.

n8cca9d5c6d.headline: Oil futures steady, balancing geopolitical fears with supply forecasts
n8cca9d5c6d.summary: Crude oil futures were steady, with traders balancing geopolitical tensions against supply forecasts, according to market coverage.
n8cca9d5c6d.why: Brent crude is the main global benchmark for oil prices, which feed into fuel costs, inflation and the earnings of energy producers.

nb1efece5d2.headline: 'Just in time': tourism industry lauds China visa shift
nb1efece5d2.summary: Australians will soon be able to enjoy a visa-free stay in China for up to 30 days, a shift the tourism industry has praised. Further details were not included in the source.
nb1efece5d2.why: Visa policy changes affect inbound tourism spending and airline and hospitality demand between the two countries.

n2cdb02e4ed.headline: Zimbabwe - High Level Meeting Aims for Comprehensive Roadmap Towards Resolving the Country
n2cdb02e4ed.summary: A sixth High-Level Structured Dialogue on Zimbabwe's arrears clearance and debt resolution process is being held to seek a comprehensive roadmap. The meeting aims to address the country's debt situation.
n2cdb02e4ed.why: Arrears clearance determines whether Zimbabwe can regain access to international lending and attract external capital.

n31610e74d5.headline: Labor notches win as time runs out on political year
n31610e74d5.summary: Labor secured a last-minute legislative win as the Greens backed its housing scheme, with several MPs also involved as the political year ended. The report gives no further detail on the scheme's terms.
n31610e74d5.why: Housing policy shapes construction activity, mortgage demand and property values, which are key inputs for Australian banks, developers and the wider economy.

n92fc4d2ed1.headline: Uruguay’s leftist opposition candidate Yamandú Orsi becomes country's new president
n92fc4d2ed1.summary: Yamandú Orsi, Uruguay's leftist opposition candidate, became the country's new president after a tight runoff. The result ousted the conservative governing coalition.
n92fc4d2ed1.why: Changes in government can shift fiscal, trade and regulatory policy, which matters for investors in Uruguayan sovereign debt and regional trade.

n8871f23c67.headline: Uruguay’s governing party concedes presidential run-off to left-wing challenger
n8871f23c67.summary: Uruguay's governing party conceded the presidential run-off to a left-wing challenger. The result ends the term of the conservative-leaning government elected in 2020.
n8871f23c67.why: Changes of government in Uruguay can shift fiscal, trade and investment policy in a small South American economy. Investors monitor such transitions for their impact on sovereign debt and policy direction.

nd78eab14a0.headline: US 10-year yields drop to 2-week low as bonds rally on Bessent pick
nd78eab14a0.summary: US Treasuries rallied on Monday as investors cheered the selection of Scott Bessent as Treasury Secretary. He is expected to keep a leash on US deficits and take a moderate approach.
nd78eab14a0.why: The 10-year Treasury yield is a benchmark for global borrowing costs, and expectations for fiscal discipline influence it.
nd78eab14a0.why_moved: Investors cheered the selection of Scott Bessent as Treasury Secretary, who is expected to keep US deficits in check, driving a bond rally.

na565376451.headline: Kingfisher shares drop on weak profit outlook, Q3 sales miss
na565376451.summary: Kingfisher shares dropped Monday after the B&Q and Screwfix owner trimmed the midpoint of its annual profit guidance, with like-for-like sales falling more than forecast.
na565376451.why: Kingfisher is a European home-improvement retailer operating B&Q and Screwfix, so its trading updates signal conditions in UK and European retail.
na565376451.why_moved: A cut to the midpoint of annual profit guidance and a weaker-than-expected third-quarter sales decline reduced expectations for earnings.

ne94a8b20a8.headline: Treasury yields fall as investors endorse Trump's Treasury secretary pick, await inflation data
ne94a8b20a8.summary: U.S. Treasury yields fell Monday as investors weighed President-elect Donald Trump's Treasury secretary pick and awaited a key inflation reading.
ne94a8b20a8.why: Treasury yields set the benchmark cost of US government borrowing and influence rates across global financial markets.
ne94a8b20a8.why_moved: Investors weighed the Treasury secretary nomination and waited for a key inflation reading, which shapes expectations for interest rates and bond demand.

n3d46f84f8c.headline: Thai banking system has large excess liquidity, central bank says
n3d46f84f8c.summary: Thailand's banking system has large excess liquidity, and the central bank has not tightened its lending supervision, an assistant governor said on Monday. He said banks are reluctant to lend.
n3d46f84f8c.why: Bank liquidity and lending supervision affect credit growth, financial stability and the outlook for Thai banks and the baht, which matter to regional investors.

n852a8f0ece.headline: Energy price cap increase creates 'perfect storm' for businesses
n852a8f0ece.summary: A rise in the energy price cap is described as creating a perfect storm for businesses, with SMEs facing financial pressure from higher energy costs and employer contributions. The report comes from London Business News.
n852a8f0ece.why: The energy price cap sets the maximum unit rates households and some businesses pay in Britain, so changes feed into inflation, consumer spending and company margins.

nb396f7201f.headline: Athens Stock Exchange: Close with a rise of 0.33% for the General Index
nb396f7201f.summary: The Athens General Index rose 0.33% to close at 1,406.20 units on 25 November 2024. Turnover topped EUR 200 million amid portfolio restructuring.
nb396f7201f.why: The Athens General Index tracks the Greek stock market, and its moves reflect investor sentiment toward Greek banks and listed companies.

nef0bf19c56.headline: LG Chem wants to buy US lithium from ExxonMobil
nef0bf19c56.summary: ExxonMobil and LG Chem signed a non-binding letter of intent for a multi-year purchase of up to 100,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate. The deal is not yet binding.
nef0bf19c56.why: LG Chem is a South Korean battery materials and chemicals group, and lithium carbonate is a key input for electric vehicle batteries.

impacts.name: ExxonMobil
impacts.why: ExxonMobil would supply lithium carbonate under a proposed multi-year purchase agreement.

nfb7809d060.headline: JBS agrees to invest $2.5 bln in Nigeria
nfb7809d060.summary: Brazilian meatpacker JBS agreed to invest $2.5 billion in Nigeria. The company plans to build six factories in the country.
nfb7809d060.why: JBS is one of the world's largest meat processors, so its investment signals foreign direct investment in African food production.

n7088750c66.headline: Brazil angry over Carrefour vow to keep Mercosur meat off shelves
n7088750c66.summary: Brazil reacted angrily to Carrefour's vow to keep Mercosur meat off its shelves. A Brazilian meat industry group called the retailer's plan contradictory.
n7088750c66.why: Carrefour is a major global retailer, and Mercosur is the South American trade bloc whose meat exports are a key trade issue.

n24f87dff72.headline: Oman's banking sector posts strong lending growth in Q3
n24f87dff72.summary: Oman's banking sector showed strong lending growth in Q3 2024. The Oman Observer said the growth reflects the country's economic stability and resilience.
n24f87dff72.why: Bank lending growth is a key indicator of credit demand and economic activity in Gulf economies.

n0f1aae4738.headline: National Insurance and £3 bus fares: Conservative councillors call for U-turn
n0f1aae4738.summary: Conservative councillors in Wakefield will consider motions calling on the government to reverse Budget plans to raise employer National Insurance contributions and lift the bus fare cap to £3.
n0f1aae4738.why: Employer National Insurance changes raise payroll costs for UK businesses, which affects hiring, margins and wider fiscal policy.

nd8ae101ad6.headline: Nymex Overview :  Early Winter Gasoline Shows Weakness as December Looms -- OPIS
nd8ae101ad6.summary: Petroleum futures fell sharply on Monday on talk of a peace deal, pushing toward the lowest US gasoline levels since spring 2021.
nd8ae101ad6.why: Gasoline futures set wholesale fuel prices that feed into US retail pump prices and refiner margins.
nd8ae101ad6.why_moved: Talk of a peace deal triggered heavy selling in petroleum futures, reducing the geopolitical risk premium in fuel prices.

n5be55c4068.headline: Nigeria's unemployment rate drops to 4.3% as hardship lingers
n5be55c4068.summary: Nigeria's unemployment rate dropped to 4.3% in the second quarter of 2024, though hardship persists according to the report.
n5be55c4068.why: Labour market data helps gauge consumer spending power and economic health in Africa's largest economy.

n8824a39c8a.headline: Super Hi Reports Unaudited Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2024
n8824a39c8a.summary: Super Hi International, operator of Haidilao hot pot restaurants, reported unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2024.
n8824a39c8a.why: Super Hi is a Haidilao restaurant operator listed on Nasdaq and the Hong Kong exchange, so its results reflect the performance of a large casual-dining chain.

n79d3742035.headline: Wales tourism tax announced as amount and start date confirmed
n79d3742035.summary: The Welsh tourism tax will vary from 75p to £1.25 a night. The change will not take effect until at least 2027.
n79d3742035.why: A visitor levy changes hotel and accommodation pricing and demand in Wales, affecting local tourism businesses.

nd0c555219c.headline: Who Has Trump Picked For Cabinet? Bessent, Chavez-DeRemer Join Nominees
nd0c555219c.summary: Donald Trump announced another batch of Cabinet nominations on Friday, including Bessent and Chavez-DeRemer. The input does not state their posts.
nd0c555219c.why: Cabinet appointments shape US economic, fiscal and trade policy, which influences US markets and global investors.

nc2b343a159.headline: Microfinance sector tightens lending norms to address asset quality stress
nc2b343a159.summary: The Microfinance Institutions Network is tightening lending rules for members, including stricter limits on lending to overdue borrowers and caps on total indebtedness, to address rising bad loans.
nc2b343a159.why: Microfinance institutions lend small loans to low-income borrowers, and rising bad loans in the sector affect lender profitability and credit access.

n97bdb273ed.headline: Cement Imports Surge 5% in 3Q 2024, Impacting Local Manufacturers
n97bdb273ed.summary: Cement imports rose 5% in the first three quarters of 2024, mostly from Vietnam despite anti-dumping duties. Local industry is calling for safeguard measures.
n97bdb273ed.why: Cement is a core construction input, and import competition affects domestic producers' margins and pricing power.

n4963d49ce9.headline: ITV surges as suitors said to be circling again
n4963d49ce9.summary: ITV shares surged on Monday after a weekend report said potential suitors have begun circling the broadcaster again following a prolonged share price slump.
n4963d49ce9.why: ITV is a UK broadcaster and media company whose share price and strategy have drawn takeover interest in recent years.
n4963d49ce9.why_moved: Shares rose after a weekend report that potential suitors have begun circling again, following a long period of share price weakness.

n3fef89d52f.headline: Fed’s recent rate cuts could improve borrowing options for state and local government projects • Nebraska Examiner
n3fef89d52f.summary: State and local governments, along with consumers, stand to benefit from the Federal Reserve's second consecutive key rate cut, according to the Nebraska Examiner.
n3fef89d52f.why: The Federal Reserve sets the benchmark US interest rate, which influences borrowing costs across the economy, including municipal bond financing.

n310106b517.headline: Hydrogen:  TotalEnergies Accelerates Decarbonization of its Platform at La Mède
n310106b517.summary: In line with its 2030 ambition, TotalEnergies has joined Air Liquide to produce renewable hydrogen at La Mède to decarbonize hydrogen used in its European refineries.
n310106b517.why: TotalEnergies is a major French integrated energy company, and its refinery hydrogen decarbonization affects operating costs and emissions targets.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies
impacts.why: The company is decarbonizing hydrogen production at its refinery site through a partnership.

n3292c5db2d.headline: Thai Household Debt Drops Below 90% of GDP for First Time in 3 Years
n3292c5db2d.summary: Thailand's household debt ratio has dropped below 90% of GDP for the first time in three and a half years, while over 414,000 Thais remain unemployed.
n3292c5db2d.why: Household debt levels shape consumer spending and credit risk for banks, which are key drivers of economic growth and financial stability.

n4405dc660b.headline: Cenovus Energy announces redemption of Series 3 Preferred Shares
n4405dc660b.summary: Cenovus Energy announced it will exercise its right to redeem its 4.689% Series 3 Preferred Shares, listed on the TSX and NYSE.
n4405dc660b.why: Cenovus is a Canadian integrated oil company, and preferred share redemptions affect its capital structure and the income paid to preferred holders.

nfa0d4c1a24.headline: New York State Shoppers Brace For Massive Egg Shortage
nfa0d4c1a24.summary: A shortage of eggs is concerning bakers ahead of Thanksgiving and affecting shoppers in New York State and across the country. The report gave no further details on supply or prices.
nfa0d4c1a24.why: Eggs are a staple food commodity, and supply disruptions can feed into consumer food inflation and retailer margins.

n9b4360981e.headline: Qudian :  Reports Third Quarter 2024 Unaudited Financial Results Form 6 K
n9b4360981e.summary: Qudian, a consumer-oriented technology company in China, has reported its unaudited third-quarter 2024 financial results. The release was issued from Xiamen.
n9b4360981e.why: Qudian operates consumer lending and credit technology in China, so its results reflect the health of China's consumer credit market.

nb852e0151c.headline: Volkswagen's swag of upcoming updates to include Polo, entire EV lineup
nb852e0151c.summary: Volkswagen is set to update its electric vehicle lineup comprehensively from 2026, with the Polo also due for an update. The report was published by Glen Innes Examiner.
nb852e0151c.why: Volkswagen is one of the world's largest carmakers, and its EV line-up determines its competitiveness in electric vehicles.

n735b7c78ec.headline: GSK's Blenrep treatment accepted for review by FDA
n735b7c78ec.summary: GSK announced that US regulators have accepted for review Blenrep combinations for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The treatment is an experimental cancer therapy under regulatory review.
n735b7c78ec.why: GSK is a global pharmaceutical company, and US Food and Drug Administration decisions can determine whether its new medicines reach the large US market.

n4ef9e0bc97.headline: Semtech Corp Q3 Earnings Summary
n4ef9e0bc97.summary: Semtech posted a third-quarter loss of $7.6 million, against $38.3 million a year earlier. Quarterly EPS was negative $0.10.
n4ef9e0bc97.why: Semtech designs semiconductors for connectivity and data infrastructure, so its results signal demand in those chip markets.

nfd2567d24f.headline: PHL still eyes re-inclusion in JPMorgan bond index
nfd2567d24f.summary: The Philippines may find it difficult to re-enter JPMorgan Chase's widely tracked emerging market bond index, according to the report.
nfd2567d24f.why: JPMorgan's emerging market bond indices are widely tracked by global funds, so inclusion decisions can drive passive bond inflows and outflows.

nf38e93d85a.headline: Scott Bessent’s Treasury appointment signals pragmatism amid Trump’s bold economic agenda: analysts
nf38e93d85a.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts believe Scott Bessent's appointment as Treasury Secretary suggests a balanced approach to Trump's trade policies.
nf38e93d85a.why: The US Treasury Secretary oversees fiscal policy, sovereign debt issuance and key economic and sanctions policy. Its leadership shapes expectations for tariffs, trade and government borrowing.

nf987e3eb98.headline: Japanese cable maker Fujikura sees stock surge 400% on AI-fueled demand for fiber optics
nf987e3eb98.summary: Japanese cable maker Fujikura's shares have surged 400%, fuelled by demand for fiber optics tied to rapid growth in AI products and research.
nf987e3eb98.why: Fujikura is a Japanese manufacturer of optical fiber and electronic cables used in data centres and telecom networks. Demand from AI infrastructure has become a key growth driver for such suppliers.
nf987e3eb98.why_moved: Demand for fiber optics linked to AI products and research has driven the share price sharply higher.

nf210aadf0e.headline: Waga Energy:  launch of a new project in Québec
nf210aadf0e.summary: Waga Energy announced a new biomethane production project in Quebec, where it will build and operate a purification unit using its own technology.
nf210aadf0e.why: Waga Energy is a French company that builds and operates biogas purification units to produce renewable biomethane. Such projects add to renewable gas supply.

n0f6a7034ed.headline: Current account deficit seen to widen
n0f6a7034ed.summary: The Philippines' current account deficit is seen widening further, which could put pressure on the currency, ANZ Research said.
n0f6a7034ed.why: The current account balance measures a country's trade and income flows with the rest of the world. A widening deficit typically needs more foreign financing and can weigh on the currency.

n1af7ccd126.headline: Germany stuck in economic weakness but rate cuts should be gradual, Nagel says
n1af7ccd126.summary: Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said Germany remains stuck in economic weakness. He argued central bank rates need to fall only gradually to fully extinguish inflation pressures.
n1af7ccd126.why: The Bundesbank is Germany's central bank and part of the eurosystem, and its views on the pace of rate cuts shape expectations for euro-area monetary policy.

n8734a6c4fa.headline: FBM KLCI jumps 15 points as banks rally ahead of results
n8734a6c4fa.summary: Malaysia's benchmark FBM KLCI rose nearly 15 points on Monday as investors bought bank stocks ahead of their corporate results this week.
n8734a6c4fa.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark index of the largest listed companies, and bank stocks carry significant weight in it.

impacts.name: FBM KLCI
impacts.why: The index rose nearly 15 points as investors bought bank stocks ahead of results.

n4e2621a63a.headline: Japan provides $248.88m for Jamuna rail bridge, Ctg sewerage system
n4e2621a63a.summary: Bangladesh and Japan signed an exchange of notes and loan agreement worth $248.88 million for the Jamuna rail bridge and a Chittagong sewerage system, the Economic Relations Division said.
n4e2621a63a.why: Official development loans fund large infrastructure projects, which can support construction and related businesses and affect public debt.

n9be654e42b.headline: 'All about jobs': minister spruiks net zero tax breaks
n9be654e42b.summary: The Labor government is defending its net zero production tax incentives, arguing that opposing the policy would cost jobs.
n9be654e42b.why: Production tax incentives for clean energy manufacturing affect investment decisions in renewable and industrial projects.

n2bd9fe6f73.headline: B.C. home sales surge 34% in October, says real estate association
n2bd9fe6f73.summary: British Columbia recorded 7,119 residential unit sales in October 2024, a 33.5% rise from a year earlier, according to the BCREA. Decreasing interest rates were cited as a factor.
n2bd9fe6f73.why: Housing sales volumes are a key indicator of consumer confidence and mortgage activity in Canada's most expensive housing markets.
